in_marathi.name: Chitti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chitti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Chitti means 'consciousness' or 'awareness'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'chitta', which refers to the mind or consciousness. In Hindu mythology, Chitti is an aspect of Goddess Parvati, the consort of Lord Shiva. She is known as the embodiment of love, compassion, and wisdom.
